answer.worked: For $y=4x+1$, plot $(-1,-3),\ (0,1),\ (1,5)$. Draw this line on the shared axes using the stated style.

For $y=\frac23x+1$, choose $x=-3,0,3$, giving $(-3,-1),\ (0,1),\ (3,3)$. Draw the line through these three exact points on the shared axes using the stated dotted style.
